proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS REPORT
proposals.proponent: New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated public report disclosing policies and monetary and non-monetary political contributions and expenditures, including trade association payments and recipients.
proposals.evidence: the Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PAY EQUITY REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by April 2018 identifying whether a gender pay gap exists among employees and outlining steps and reduction targets to reduce it.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 7.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PROXY ACCESS REFORM
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend proxy access bylaws by removing the 20-stockholder aggregation limit and raising the nominee cap to one quarter of directors or two.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 8.
